pages.en:
—The city falls asleep.

It is only a little after ten, yet the night has the depth of two in the morning.

Perhaps the continuing coma incidents are responsible.

No lights burn in the city beneath the curtain of night, and not a single person can be seen outside.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The town falls asleep.
It’s just past ten o’clock, but it seems like it’s midnight.
It must be because of all the unexplained comas.
There are no lights, and nobody is walking about.

“Yes. But we have no choice. Are you against it, Saber?”
